title: PersonaLens: A Benchmark for Personalization Evaluation in Conversational AI Assistants
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion' as one of the five key demographic variables used to construct user profiles for the benchmark. It specifically tracks and reports the distribution of various religious identities (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Agnostic, etc.) and uses these profiles to evaluate how well AI assistants personalize responses to diverse user backgrounds.
